subject: Copywriting
title: Patek Philippe: Generations of Copy
description: A micro-lesson that makes Patek Philippe: Generations of Copy usable.

hook.text: 'You never actually own a Patek Philippe.

discovery.text: The copy reframes a purchase as stewardship. You're not spending $50,000—you're investing in a family heirloom.

twist.text: Patek Philippe watches appreciate in value.

climax.text: The tagline invented emotional luxury watch marketing. Before it, watch ads listed complications.

punchline.text: You never actually own it. The line that turned watches into family heirlooms.

quiz.question: When did the Patek Philippe 'Generations' campaign launch?
